name: Windscribe
author: Windscribe
description: Windscribe VPN, built for Omarchy: a live world map of every location, one-click connect, kill switch, live tunnel traffic, favorites and recents, protocol picker, and in-panel install and sign-in — all drawn from your theme, all powered by windscribe-cli.

barWidget.description: Control Windscribe VPN: connect on a world map, switch locations, watch tunnel traffic, and toggle the kill switch from the bar.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Status poll interval while the panel is closed. Open panel polls every 3 seconds.

schema.label: Preferred protocol
schema.description: Optional: wireguard, udp, tcp, stealth, or wstunnel (with an optional :port). Applied on the next connect; leave empty for the app default.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: "on" or "off". Notifies on connect and on unexpected drops.
